newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EMU starters to be chosen end-April, early-May 1998.
newsitem.headline: EMU starters to be chosen end-April, early-May 1998.

text.p: European Union finance ministers agreed on Saturday the EU should make its decision on which countries qualify to join monetary union in 1999 at the end of April or in early May next year, European Monetary Affairs Commissioner Yves Thibault de Silguy told reporters.
De Silguy added that the European Commission and European Monetary Institute recommendations on which countries would qualify for the first wave of EMU would be ready by the end of March, 1998.
As to those recommendations, there would then be a period of four to five weeks for parliamentary consultation.
EU finance ministers and heads of state would then meet over a single weekend to decide which countries join the euro at its planned launch on January 1, 1999.
This weekend would be at the "end of April, start of May", de Silguy said.

Officials at the informal EU meeting in the Dutch coastal town of Noordwijk declined comment on speculation that the likely selection date would be on Friday, May 1, 1998 -- a scheduled holiday for many financial markets.
